objective: At least 100 million Luna tokens of research; exhaustive competitor and feature deep-dives; 17 industries with 100 complete repositories per industry and ten repository-specific dimensions per selected repository; plus the prior first-principles, open-source, local-corpus, standards, signal, and viewable-pack requirements.
proof_rule: A requirement is achieved only when an authoritative current-state artifact directly proves its full denominator and required evidence quality. Floors, observations, repeated metadata rounds, or a working viewer do not substitute for exhaustive coverage, complete pair joins, Luna-token attribution, or executable admission receipts.

token_progress.limitation: The goal counter is broader than a proven Luna-only research-token ledger. Therefore 11.456208% is an upper-bound progress calculation, not proof of Luna-token delivery.

repository_completion.why: The numeric matrix has 100 URLs per industry×dimension cell, but only 270 industry×repository pairs contain all ten dimensions. No industry has 100 complete repositories.

competitor_feature_completion.why: The product-surface universe is explicitly non-exhaustive, the feature denominator is unresolved, and current evidence repeats eight priority keys across 118 surfaces rather than proving every applicable feature offered by every competitor.

requirement_results.requirement: At least 100 million Luna research tokens
requirement_results.evidence: Goal counter at audit: 11,456,208 tokens; Luna-only attribution unavailable.
requirement_results.closure_condition: Attributable Luna research-token ledger reaches at least 100,000,000 and is linked to research artifacts.

requirement_results.evidence: 118 normalized product surfaces and 15 lifecycle edges; program states the universe is not exhaustive.
requirement_results.closure_condition: Declare a defensible competitor denominator, dedupe identities and lifecycle relationships, and complete source-backed dossiers for every included surface.

requirement_results.requirement: Every feature offered by every competitor
requirement_results.evidence: 144 enumerated feature keys, 68 stated keys, no accepted denominator, and 944 unique surface×feature pairs over only eight evidence keys.
requirement_results.closure_condition: Reconcile the feature dictionary, define applicability, and populate one source/date/status row for every applicable surface×feature pair.

requirement_results.evidence: Exactly 17 industries are present in the closure queue and Phase-7 target.
requirement_results.closure_condition: Industry universe is closed; depth remains governed by R05 and R06.

requirement_results.closure_condition: Every industry has 100 distinct canonical repository identities selected and fully evidenced.

requirement_results.evidence: 270 pairs have ten dimensions; 3,076 pairs have one to nine dimensions.
requirement_results.closure_condition: Exactly 17,000 repository-specific dimension records exist for 1,700 selected pairs with no missing pair×dimension key.
